_comment: API routes that no screen is meant to call: they serve other programs, links in emails, or sign-in itself. Each pattern needs a reason. `/**` matches everything beneath a path.

routes./api/v1/**: The public REST API, called with an API key.
routes./api/mcp: The MCP server endpoint, called by MCP clients.
routes./api/oauth/**: OAuth for MCP clients: discovery, registration, token exchange.
routes./api/auth/[...nextauth]: NextAuth's own handler, reached through its client library.
routes./api/t/**: Open and click tracking and the unsubscribe page, reached from links inside sent emails.
routes./api/health: Liveness and readiness probe for the container platform.
routes./api/email-health: Kept for the MCP tool email_health and for API callers. The Deliverability screen reads /api/deliverability.
routes./api/platform/settings: Kept for the MCP application-settings tool. The Mailboxes screen changes the same switches through /api/email-accounts/settings.
